title: Implement MARBLE MultiAgentTaskScheduler and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task MultiAgentTaskScheduler (task_id=90 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-330/solution.py per assets/gc-330/SPEC.md: a deterministic auto-assignment engine with capacities, priorities, agent outages with requeueing, an append-only event history, messaging, and task search. The event-log identity test enforces the exact assignment order, so plan the scheduling loop before coding, implement in increments, and rerun the sealed suite after each increment while tracking red tests by name. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-330/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that writes out the auto-assignment loop and its tie-breaking rules
The sealed suite was executed after each increment with logs retained, including at least one red run before the final green
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-330/solution.py
